info.name: Delivez - Core 4 Services API (Courier, Luggage, Confidential, Forgot Something)
info.description:
Complete, production-ready Postman collection for Delivez delivery services:

1. Personal Courier Delivery
2. Luggage Delivery
3. Confidential Delivery (Vault)
4. Forgot Something (Item Retrieval)

Includes automated token management, dynamic quotes, bookings creation, tracking, OTP verifications, sandbox payments, cancellations, and live audit logging.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: Authentication endpoints to obtain User Access Token and Admin Access Token. Test scripts will automatically save the tokens to environment variables.

request.description: Logs in customer user and stores {{accessToken}} into the active Postman environment.
Logs in platform administrator and stores {{adminAccessToken}} into the active Postman environment.
Returns the currently logged in user profile.

Returns unified real-time order stream across Courier, Luggage, Confidential, and Forgot Something.

item.name: Screen Component 10: Service Sliders & Showcase Cards
item.description: Dynamic multi-image service showcase cards & promotional carousels for the 5 delivery services. Mobile apps render these cards with multiple images, badges, headings, descriptions, and deep-link CTA buttons.

request.description: Returns all active cards across all services sorted by priority order.
